<!-- nativecmpkit-resolution:UI-024:important-20261028 -->
## Verified resolution — closing directly after important source/results review

The availability check now compares `(major, minor)` lexicographically. iOS18.0/26.0 no longer fall into the obsolete path. **Before17.4 (or a malformed version), the public API uses the caller’s required Material `materialContent` with its popup/styling parameters.** No private `UITouchDownGestureRecognizer` lookup, synthetic touch or invented category-super dispatch remains.

Both original acceptance criteria are satisfied:
1. `DropDownAvailabilityTest.comparesMajorAndMinorLexicographically` executes17.3,17.4,17.10,18.0,26.0,26.4 and malformed versions, verifying the intended branch.
2. `NativeDropDownLifecycleTest.expandedStateControlsActualMenuAndDismissalIsNotReportedAtOpen` exercises the **actual attached UIKit control**: `expanded=true` opens via public `performPrimaryAction`, `expanded=false` closes, it reopens, and public UIKit dismissal emits its real completion without a dismissal-at-open. The older-version Material fallback is explicit/documented above, not claimed as an executed older OS.

**Inspected evidence reused, not rerun:** [run40522929974, attempt2](https://github.com/Apdelrahman1911/nativeCmpkit/actions/runs/40522929974/attempts/2), immutable `202059090bbbf896d07d38a3441cf21c8888c63b`, iPhone/iOS26.5 simulator, Xcode26.6/JDK17. The two owning XML each report1/1, zero failure/error/skip; they are a subset of the original121/121, not extra executions. Command `:calf-ui:iosSimulatorArm64ApplicationTest` exited0. The four owning production/test files are byte-identical at current `9b7a89fab2a6364b7d55ce0c961e2fff070ae58a`. Actual application/Worker completion and cleanup were reviewed in the existing accepted receipt.

Code: `calf-ui/src/commonMain/kotlin/com/mohamedrejeb/calf/ui/dropdown/DropDownAvailability.kt` and `calf-ui/src/iosMain/kotlin/com/mohamedrejeb/calf/ui/dropdown/AdaptiveDropDown.ios.kt`.

Scope remains individual: no actual older-runtime/physical iPad/VoiceOver/ABI or release certification; separate #131/UI-025 interaction requirements and broader platform/security/consumer gates remain open. All original body/labels/attribution/history and failed-attempt evidence are preserved. Closing as **completed**, not treating the wider release as ready.
